mapper.select: SELECT id, `key`, lang, value, created_date, updated_date FROM translations WHERE lang = #{lang} ORDER BY `key`
SELECT id, `key`, lang, value, created_date, updated_date FROM translations ORDER BY lang, `key`
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO translations (`key`, lang, value, created_date, updated_date) VALUES (#{key}, #{lang}, #{value}, NOW(), NOW())
INSERT INTO translations (`key`, lang, value, created_date, updated_date) VALUES (#{key}, #{lang}, #{value}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE value = #{value}, updated_date = NOW()
